title: Prioritizing missense mutations via a deep learning phosphorylation prediction model.
summary: DeepMEP predicts missense mutation effects on phosphorylation from flanking sequence and reports enrichment of high-effect predictions among Alzheimer and Parkinson disease GWAS loci; this is a computational prioritization result, not experimental confirmation of each variant. The result is reported in Human Genomics. Affiliation was not available in checked primary metadata; no organization is assigned. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material.
